hotel_name: The Ritz Carlton Bahrain Hotel & Spa

claims.text: The hotel spans 70 acres of private beachfront around a lagoon in Manama.

findings.quote: this 7-story, 260-room family hotel in Manama spans 70 acres of private beachfront around a picturesque lagoon

claims.text: The Royal Beach Club offers access to a private beach, lagoon and marina.

findings.quote: The Royal Beach Club offers access to a private beach, lagoon, and marina.

claims.text: The three-bedroom villas have direct beach access and a private pool.

findings.quote: Our 3 bedroom villas offer luxury accommodation, direct beach access and private pool

claims.text: The Club Level is on the 6th and 7th floors and is described as a hotel within a hotel.

findings.quote: Located on the 6th and 7th floors, the Club Level offers the comfort, convenience, and intimacy of a hotel within a hotel.
findings.note: Floors and hotel within a hotel

claims.text: The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.

findings.quote: Five times each day, the Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.

claims.text: Nirvana is a fine dining Indian restaurant with kebabs, grilled seafood and live traditional music.

findings.quote: this fine dining restaurant offers authentic dishes, including kebabs and grilled seafood, accompanied by live traditional music.
findings.note: Fine dining, kebabs, seafood, live music

findings.quote: Indian at Nirvana

claims.text: Cantina Kahlo is a Mexican restaurant with decor inspired by Mexico's art scene.

findings.quote: an authentic Mexican restaurant in Manama, Bahrain, with décor inspired by Mexico's vibrant art scene

claims.text: Plums is a modern steakhouse whose specialties are premium cuts of meat and fresh seafood.

findings.quote: this modern steakhouse offers dishes as rich as the décor itself. Premium cuts of meat and fresh seafood are the specialties.

claims.text: Afternoon tea is served daily in the Lobby Lounge, with a classical duo playing.

findings.quote: exquisite melodies from a classical duo provide the perfect environment in which to relax over a world-famous Ritz-Carlton afternoon tea. The traditional high tea is served daily

claims.text: The spa uses Dead Sea minerals and has a thalassotherapy pool.

findings.quote: Minerals from the Dead Sea and our authentic thalassotherapy pool are among the water-inspired elements at this luxury spa in Bahrain.

claims.text: The Royal Beach Club has a Turkish hammam with four plunge pools at different temperatures.

findings.quote: Traditional Turkish Hammam consisting of four plunge pools set at different temperatures
findings.note: Hammam with four plunge pools, listed under Royal Beach Club

findings.quote: temperature-controlled indoor and outdoor pools, a hammam, Pearl 1 boating and kids activities
findings.note: Royal Beach Club includes a hammam

claims.text: Ritz Kids welcomes children aged 4 to 12 to join its activities.

findings.quote: Children aged 4 to 12 are welcome to join our exciting activities.

claims.text: Ta Plage Privée is on the resort's private island and offers an air-conditioned private tent, a dedicated massage room and an exclusive beach.

findings.quote: private island off the coast of the Arabian Gulf, Ta Plage Privée offers the utmost in seclusion
With an air-conditioned private tent where you can relax, along with a dedicated massage room and your very own exclusive beach

claims.text: The three-bedroom villas have direct beach access and a private pool.

findings.quote: Our 3 bedroom villas offer luxury accommodation, direct beach access and private pool

claims.text: La Table Krug is described by the hotel as the region's first and smallest fine dining restaurant.

findings.quote: La Table Krug arrives as the region's first and smallest fine dining restaurant.

claims.text: The spa uses Dead Sea minerals and has a thalassotherapy pool.

findings.quote: Minerals from the Dead Sea and our authentic thalassotherapy pool are among the water-inspired elements at this luxury spa in Bahrain.

claims.text: The resort's Pearl 1 boat runs daily sea excursions along the coast, including dolphin watching.

findings.quote: Pearl 1 boat for daily excursions that will have you exploring hidden enclaves
watching beautiful dolphins, and more

claims.text: The minimum age to enter the spa is 16.

findings.quote: Minimum age for guest to enter the spa is 16 years old.

claims.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not give complimentary Club access.

findings.quote: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

claims.text: During Ramadan, the hotel's restaurant operations change.

findings.quote: During the Holy Month of Ramadan, we would like to inform you that there are changes to our restaurant operations.
